import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_10/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_10/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on Postalcode
df = pd.merge(df1, df0, on="Postalcode", how="inner")

# Create 'Neighborhood_joined' column as a copy of 'Neighborhood'
df["Neighborhood_joined"] = df["Neighborhood"]

# Reorder columns to match target schema
df = df[["Postalcode", "Latitude", "Longitude", "Borough", "Neighborhood", "Neighborhood_joined"]]

# Ensure correct dtypes
df["Postalcode"] = df["Postalcode"].astype(str)
df["Latitude"] = df["Latitude"].astype(float)
df["Longitude"] = df["Longitude"].astype(float)
df["Borough"] = df["Borough"].astype(str)
df["Neighborhood"] = df["Neighborhood"].astype(str)
df["Neighborhood_joined"] = df["Neighborhood_joined"].astype(str)

# Write to target path without index
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_10/target_multisource.csv"
df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_10/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_10/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on Postalcode
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Postalcode", how="inner")

# Add Neighborhood_joined column same as Neighborhood
joined["Neighborhood_joined"] = joined["Neighborhood"]

# Group by Postalcode, Borough, Neighborhood to ensure uniqueness and correct aggregation
# Use first() aggregation for Latitude and Longitude since they are functionally dependent on Neighborhood (key)
grouped = joined.groupby(["Postalcode", "Borough", "Neighborhood"], as_index=False).agg({
    "Latitude": "first",
    "Longitude": "first",
    "Neighborhood_joined": "first"
})

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
final = grouped[["Postalcode", "Latitude", "Longitude", "Borough", "Neighborhood", "Neighborhood_joined"]]

# Write output
final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_10/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
